catalog.title: Guessed `t.state` on a `renderComponent()` handle (it has `t.states`, `t.next()`, `t.waitForState()`; no `state`)
`t.html()` read before the first render (returns `''`; await `t.ready()` / `t.next()` first)
First event/action right after `renderComponent()` is silently lost

selfReported: One gap in that last test: it relies on the test helper accepting a reply to the cancelled request without throwing (it does, but I wrapped the calls in `try` just in case).
It shows a stale reply doesn't change the screen, but if the helper ever started throwing, the test would still pass without testing anything.
